interface.shortDescription: Report Codex task status to Mewmori.
interface.longDescription: Reports only a task title, lifecycle status, and short user-safe summary to the local Mewmori app. It never sends prompts, terminal output, diffs, file contents, or secrets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Report this task's lifecycle to Mewmori without including prompts, terminal output, diffs, file contents, or secrets.
